To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the user can steer the clustering process with his knowledge; 2) the user can monitor and evaluate the result; 3) the user can post-process the result; 4) the user can visualize and understand the result.
1) the human involvement in clustering is inevitable, and 2) the visual framework (Vista) is the best approach to support the human involvement.
(1) the human is a crucial part of clustering and (2) a visualization of the clustering process and its results helps to understand the clustering process, to steer it and to refine it.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a visual framework that supports the user to interact with the clustering process, and that allows the user to understand the patterns in a fast and precise manner.
the design of a framework that supports the clustering-analysis process in a way that the user can interact with it, understand the result, and evaluate it.
the design, implementation and evaluation of a visualization framework for clustering.
